description:
A well presented 3 bedroom semi-detached residence with a stylish open plan ground floor, driveway parking and approx. 55 ft garden.
 This charming family home has been improved to include a 17’ kitchen dining room with a good degree of storage via a range of base units and matching eye level wall cupboards. There is a useful entrance porch with a door into the hallway and stairs leading to the first floor with storage cupboard beneath. The living room benefits from a fireplace with alcoves to each side of the chimney breast and a half-bay window to the front. Upstairs includes a white family bathroom and 3 bedrooms, all of which have built in storage/wardrobe space.

The property is offered to the market with no onward chain and scope for extension subject to the necessary consents.

Outside there is off road parking and a shared drive providing access to the garage and established garden.

Kennington is a particularly popular choice for families, known for its strong sense of community and excellent local amenities. The village offers a well regarded primary school, local shops, a traditional pub, church. There are pleasant green spaces nearby and opportunities for outdoor activities along the Thames. For commuters, the location is equally appealing. There are regular bus services to Oxford and Abingdon, while nearby Radley station provides direct rail links to London Paddington. The A34 is easily accessible, connecting to the M4 and M40, making travel further afield straightforward.

Council Tax Band: D
